title: Add JSON output for memory compaction
summary: Add `--json` output for `covenant memory compact` so compaction automation can consume a single outcome envelope instead of parsing human summaries.
expectedFailureModes: Operators cannot safely automate compaction because the CLI only prints human text and the report format drifts.
Dry-run and apply outcomes are indistinguishable to supervisors without fragile string matching.
Live compaction coverage exists but cannot assert a stable compaction outcome contract.
